mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that suppresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 months, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between PAYEMS and UNRATE is not significant (p>0.05) in regression analysis, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing-led expansion regime (HOUST > 1250 thousand units and INDPRO > 102.5), rising home construction and industrial activity signal robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates strong manufacturing output that supports corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.025 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC is negative over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS is not significant (p>0.05), or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), persistent inflation forces restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.02.
